1170-2397-4124-5954-8345.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

2301-4279-6578--216.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2301-4279-6578--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2866-3899-4708-4986.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5256-6273.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3388-4865.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3388-4865.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Moritte of the Frost each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3388-4865.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

719-2034-3490-7665.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
719-2034-3490-7665.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters as a Hero due to Xenograft, Captain America triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Servo.
Animation Module triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-4184-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
2034-4184-6972.notes: If Relentless Skaabs starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1770-6252-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
1770-6252-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

730-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1308-2457-4289-7060.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

97-5220-6900.description:
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing itself.
When Ravenous Baloth dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ravenous Baloth on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Ravenous Baloth ability, causing you to gain 4 life.
Cast Ravenous Baloth from the top of your library by paying 4 life.
Repeat.

3053-3525-3918.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two basic land types among lands you control
3053-3525-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

527-5140-6797.manaNeeded: {G}, plus {R} if Selvala has summoning sickness
527-5140-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater that isn't Selvala.
527-5140-6797.description:
If Selvala has summoning sickness, activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving all creatures haste until end of turn.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Selvala, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
527-5140-6797.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1927-5657-6489.manaNeeded: {4}{C}{C}{C}{G/U}{G/U} plus enough mana to cast the additional Eldrazi spell
1927-5657-6489.notablePrerequisites: You have another Eldrazi creature card in hand.
1927-5657-6489.description:
Cast any other Eldrazi except Drowner of Truth by paying its mana cost, triggering Ulalek.
Holding priority, cast Drowner of Truth by paying {4}{C}{G/U}{G/U}.
Drowner of Truth and Ulalek trigger.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Drowner of Truth's trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1447-1734-2438.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5805--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
2034-5805--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with persist, adding {2}.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, as well as a +1/+1 counter due to Gev.
The +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters on that creature are removed as a state-based action.
Repeat.

277-5413-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
277-5413-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

396-2034-4144.notablePrerequisites:
It is your upkeep step.
You control at least three artifacts.
396-2034-4144.description:
During your upkeep, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kuldotha Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kuldotha Phoenix by paying {4}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kuldotha Phoenix enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Unicorn, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

215-1789-2397-5130.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
215-1789-2397-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing another artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it and Lathliss trigger twice.
Resolve both Realm-Scorcher Hellkite triggers, adding {5}{R}{R}{G}.
Resolve both Lathliss triggers, creating two 5/5 Dragon creature tokens.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Realm-Scorcher Hellkite to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1692-1803-3951-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Éomer.
Kari Zev does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1692-1803-3951-5231.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Éomer with haste.
Declare Kari Zev as an attacker.
Kari Zev triggers, creating a legendary 2/1 Ragavan creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Ragavan, adding {R}.
When Ragavan dies, each Éomer that hasn't triggered this turn triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get at least one additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1348-2179-3206-3438-3664.notablePrerequisites: Manascape Refractor does not have summoning sickness.
1348-2179-3206-3438-3664.description:
Activate Manascape Refractor using Inkmoth Nexus' second ability by paying {1}.
Kurkesh triggers, choose not to pay.
Resolve the Manascape Refractor ability, causing it to become a 1/1 Blinkmoth artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Manascape Refractor as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Manascape Refractor.
Activate Manascape Refractor using Maze of Ith's ability by tapping it, targeting itself.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Manascape Refractor's ability, targeting Manascape Refractor.
Resolve the copy of Manascape Refractor's ability, untapping it.
Activate Manascape Refractor using Lotus Field's ability by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the original Manascape Refractor ability from step 6, untapping it.
Repeat from step 6.

543-2021-2445.notablePrerequisites: Colossus of Akros is not monstrous.
543-2021-2445.description:
Activate Colossus of Akros by paying {10}, putting twenty +1/+1 counters on it and causing it to become monstrous.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting twenty growth counters on itself.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

876-2034-4289-5200-5251.notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns attached to Emmara, Soul of the Accord.
876-2034-4289-5200-5251.description:
Use Cryptolith Rite to tap Emmara, Soul of the Accord for {1}.
Emmara, Soul of the Accord triggers creating a token creature.
Use Cryptolith Rite to tap the token creature for {1}.
Sacrifice the token creature to Ashnod's Altar floating {2}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns to untap Emmara, Soul of the Accord.
Repeat.

1987-2556-3075-3448.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1987-2556-3075-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
